turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear, you must rest. Do not worry about such things. I will take care of our son and the maid. You have given us a good life and I shall continue your good work.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will take good care of the eldest son and his father, my lord and lady, and I will fulfill all my duties diligently.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know you will take care of them, Wang Lung. But I must see my son married before I leave this world. Can you make sure this happens?

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please rest. I will do everything in my power to see to your wishes. I will find a wife who will care for me as you have cared for our family.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I trust you, my son. But it is my wish to see it done before I go. Please, Wang Lung, see to it.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear O-lan, rest assured. I will make sure our son is married before you leave us. I promise to honor your wishes.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please do not worry. Father will take care of everything. I will do my best to help.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am grateful, my son. And to you, Wang Lung, I am deeply thankful. Let us not waste time, for each moment counts.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear, you rest now. I will see to everything. Your wishes will be fulfilled.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Thank you, my son. Now, we must speak to the maid about preparing for the wedding.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will ensure everything is prepared, O-lan. Please rest, and let me handle the arrangements.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I trust you, my daughter-in-law. Please make sure the arrangements are done swiftly and with care.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will, O-lan. I will make sure everything is ready for the wedding.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My wife, you need not worry. Our son will be married as you wish, and our family will flourish. Rest now.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, I know you will see to it, but please, ensure the maid understands the importance of this. My son deserves a wedding that honors him and his bride.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will speak to her myself, O-lan. She will understand the importance of this day.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will speak to the arrangements immediately, Wang Lung. I understand the gravity of this moment and will ensure everything is perfect for your son and his bride.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Rest easy, my wife. I will see to everything with my own hands. Our son shall be married as befits his station.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Thank you, Wang Lung. And you, maid, see to it that my son's wedding is a day to remember. I rest now, for I must see him married as I have always dreamed.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear, rest now. I will make sure every detail is perfect for our son. Do not worry about a thing.

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]
